title: Bluesky, developer platform enrichers, Discord invites, Docker Hub and GitLab users (P099-P103)
owner: batch p2-G05-1 (bluesky, npm_maintainer, pypi_package, codeberg_user, devto_user, huggingface_user, discord_invite, dockerhub, gitlab_user; rule p2g051_shared_key_fingerprint)

attributes.bsky_profile: Bluesky account facts {did, handle, handle_valid, custom_domain, posts, labels, verified_status, indexed_at, checked_at}: handles can be transferred, so checked_at is kept (P099 cond 5)
attributes.bsky_domain_link: custom-domain handle check {domain, did, handle, confidence confirmed|possible, basis, problems, checked_at}: CONFIRMED only when getProfile returns that handle and resolveHandle (and DNS TXT _atproto when it answers) the same DID (P099 cond 5)
attributes.handle_history: dated handle and hosting history of an AT Protocol DID from the PLC audit log {timeline [{handle, pds, date}], entries_total, truncated, dropped, nullified_skipped, tombstoned_at}: case-bound (P099 cond 7)
attributes.self_hosted_pds: AT Protocol PDS endpoints outside Bluesky's own hosting seen in a DID's history (infrastructure run by the account holder or a third party)
attributes.candidate_accounts: accounts a platform name search returned for an analyst-typed term ('candidate accounts named like X'): list of {handle, did, display_name, created}; POSSIBLE, never identity links (P099 cond 8)
attributes.platform_summary: one summary row per developer platform {platform, found, created, created_basis, count, count_kind, top (<= 5)} (P100 cond 7)
attributes.registry_packages: packages of a public registry attributed to the investigated account: list of {name, version, date, roles, repository, url}; co-maintainers and organisations are counted, never listed (P100 cond 6)
attributes.third_party_counts: people, addresses and packages of third parties seen in an answer but never kept (counted only), e.g. {co_maintainers, other_emails, system_publishers, not_seed_packages} (P100 cond 6, P102 cond 4)
attributes.pypi_project: PyPI project facts {name, version, summary, first_release, last_release, release_count, organization, seed_role, role_count, project_urls}
attributes.organizations: organisation names the account belongs to on the platform (public membership shown by the platform)
attributes.profile_url: public profile URL of the account on its platform
attributes.public_email: e-mail the account owner published on the profile (self-published personal data: case-bound, expand=False, never sent to breach or stealer modules automatically)
attributes.job_title: self-declared job title of a public profile
attributes.account_state: state of the account on its platform {state, locked} (e.g. GitLab active|blocked)
attributes.is_bot: bool: the platform marks the account as a bot or service account
attributes.discord_invite: resolved Discord invite {code, invite_type, guild {id, name, description, vanity_url_code, verification_level, nsfw, nsfw_level, features}, channel {id, name, type}, members, presence, expires_at, permanent, inviter {id, username, global_name, bot}} (P101 cond 4; guild text is server-owner controlled)
attributes.snowflake_dates: creation dates decoded from Discord snowflake ids by the shared core decoder: list of {role, id, created} (P101 cond 4)
attributes.exfil_channels: exfiltration channels found in an IOC context and never contacted: list of {kind, channel_id, fingerprint {type, preview, sha256}, requested: false} (P101 cond 5)
attributes.docker_repositories: most recently updated public repositories of a Docker Hub namespace (<= 5, one page): list of {name, description, stars, pulls, last_updated, registered}
attributes.docker_images: latest tag inspected per repository (Hub API only, layers never pulled): list of {repo_tag, os, architecture, digest, last_pushed, layers, base_boundary}
attributes.label_email_counts: image LABEL/MAINTAINER e-mails {kept, discarded, inherited}: only case e-mails or addresses on the account's own verified domain are kept (P102 cond 4)
attributes.layer_exposures: secrets seen in public image layer instructions, never validated or used: list of {type, preview, sha256, repo_tag, instruction_index, instruction_kind, variable, severity, documentation_example}; dropped passwords keep only type and index (P102 cond 5)

relations.official_account: domain -> account whose verified handle is that domain (Bluesky custom-domain handle, P099 cond 3)
relations.handle_domain: account -> domain used as its handle (custom-domain handle): CONFIRMED only when DID-consistent, for passive modules only (P099 cond 5/8)
relations.previous_handle: account -> handle the same DID used before (PLC audit log): historical, expand=False, fed to username checks only on analyst confirmation (P099 cond 7)
relations.named_like: search term -> candidate account named like it (POSSIBLE, never an identity link, P099 cond 8)
relations.maintainer_email: account -> e-mail of its own maintainer/author record on a package registry or forge profile (P100 cond 5: PROBABLE only when already a case e-mail)
relations.image_label_email: account -> e-mail in a LABEL/MAINTAINER instruction of its own public image (P102 cond 4)
relations.project_url: package -> URL declared in its metadata (homepage, source, tracker)
relations.invite_creator: invite -> account that created it (Discord inviter, expand=False, P101 cond 4)
relations.invite_guild: invite -> name of the server it leads to (server-owner text, P101 cond 4)
